import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/boamp-data-quality-pilot')
source = root / 'official-query.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
screen_path = root / 'captured-scope-screen.json'
screen = json.loads(screen_path.read_text())
original = json.loads(raw)
records = screen['records']
assert screen['source_sha256'] == digest
assert len(records) == len(original['results']) == 5
assert {r['idweb'] for r in records} == {r['idweb'] for r in original['results']}
assert all(not r['matched_phrases_by_field'] for r in records)
verdict = {
    'decision': 'NO_CANDIDATE_ESTABLISHED_IN_CAPTURE',
    'source': str(source),
    'source_sha256': digest,
    'scope_screen': str(screen_path),
    'records_screened': [r['idweb'] for r in records],
    'filter_application': 'UNVERIFIED',
    'limitation': 'The saved phrase screen found no matches in five returned records. This verdict covers the capture and screen only. It does not establish market coverage or exclude requirements in unread tender documents.',
    'reopen_on': 'A verified filtered capture or an original open buyer notice with explicit paid data-quality scope, an observable acceptance criterion, and a permitted response route.',
    'submission': 'NONE',
    'paid_acceptance': 'UNVERIFIED',
    'settlement': 'UNVERIFIED'
}
out = root / 'bounded-verdict.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(verdict, indent=2) + '\n')
print(out.read_text())
